notes.title: Release Notes for Version 1.1
notes.content:
Features

 Achievement tracking with 18 new achievements
 Stats tracking with 40+ new player stats
 New Character Mastery system, featuring XP and levels
 New Stats and Mastery display menu
 Added Steam Cloud Saving support

Adjustments

 Ophelia: -1 HP
 Ophelia: Passive now loses Health on collision
 Ophelia: Passive grants 1 extra DMG when at 1 HP

notes.title: Release Notes for Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Resolved a bug that caused CPU difficulty settings to not update correctly. Each difficulty level has also been fully reworked.
 Achievements now appear on the store page! While they can't be unlocked yet, they'll be available in version 1.1—stay tuned!

notes.title: Release Notes for Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Added tracking of in-game stats in preparation for future updates.
 Don Gordo now only steals as many bullets as he can hold.
 Slightly lowered all CPU difficulties.
 Fixed visual effects for stats exceeding their limit.
 Fixed damage overlay showing the wrong color for healing.
 Enhanced visual elements in the tutorial.
 Made the tutorial replayable.
 Default health bars setting reduced to 1
 Custom song loader now supports MP3 files.
